caption: The video captures a single large iridescent soap bubble drifting through a dormant outdoor landscape. A mown grassy field fills the foreground, backed by dry tan brush and a stand of bare, leafless trees under an overcast sky. The bubble, rimmed in blue-green with yellow and magenta sheen, hangs in the left-center of the view, its middle crossed by a dark horizontal band reflecting the distant treeline. The bubble drifts slowly to the right relative to the near-static background. Its silhouette deforms as it floats, starting as a broad, irregular oval and growing progressively taller and narrower toward a more rounded form. The dark reflection band stays broadly horizontal, with only slight changes in angle. The bubble remains whole and airborne throughout, with no contact or burst visible. The trees and brush remain largely fixed, so the bubble's rightward drift is visible against the background.
